name: Kinga Kollár - Proposition de décision du Conseil
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the Union, of the Amending Protocol to the Agreement between the European Union and the Principality of Liechtenstein on the automatic exchange of financial account information to improve international tax compliance
part_text:
The European Parliament approves a new agreement with Liechtenstein on sharing bank account information automatically. This updates the existing 2015 deal so it matches the latest international rules, which now also cover electronic money products and central bank digital currencies. It also updates data protection references to the EU's General Data Protection Regulation. The aim is to help tax authorities catch tax evasion and money laundering. The new rules apply from 1 January 2026.

- The deal now covers electronic money products and central bank digital currencies, and updates data protection references.
- It affects tax authorities and financial institutions in EU member states and Liechtenstein.
- Parliament approved it; the Council can now formally conclude the agreement, with new rules applying from 1 January 2026.
